opening_message:
Ticket 1: Matthew Mejia (employee ID E034) requests write access to Payroll.

Team memory: 6 note(s) about employee E034.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Analyst (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Matthew Mejia (E034) is a full-time Analyst. Requested write access to Payroll. As a full-time employee, max standard access is write (admin requires owning role, which Analyst does not for Payroll). Requested level equals maximum, so recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by IT agent:
  - role: Analyst (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: IT lookup confirms Matthew Mejia (E034) is an Analyst. HR reports full-time employment. As a full-time Analyst, max access to Payroll is write (admin requires owning role; Analyst does not own Payroll). Requested write equals the maximum, so recommend write.
Note 3 (ticket 1), written by Finance agent:
  - role: Analyst (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Finance lookup confirms Matthew Mejia (E034) is an Analyst. HR/IT report full-time employment. As a full-time Analyst, max access to Payroll is write (admin requires the owning role, Payroll Specialist; Analyst does not own Payroll). Requested write equals the maximum, so recommend write.
Note 4 (ticket 1), written by Compliance agent:
  - role: Analyst (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Compliance lookup confirms Matthew Mejia (E034) is an Analyst. HR/IT/Finance report full-time employment. As a full-time Analyst, max access to Payroll is write (admin requires the owning role, Payroll Specialist; Analyst does not own Payroll). Requested write equals the maximum, so recommend write.
Note 5 (ticket 1), written by Facilities agent:
  - role: Analyst (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent, note 4 by Compliance agent)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent, note 4 by Compliance agent)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Facilities lookup confirms Matthew Mejia (E034) is an Analyst. HR reports full-time employment. As a full-time Analyst, max access to Payroll is write (admin requires the owning role, Payroll Specialist; Analyst does not own Payroll). Requested write equals the maximum, so recommend write.
Note 6 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB lookup for Matthew Mejia (E034) shows contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training — never admin. With basic training, max access is read. Requested write exceeds max, so recommend read.
reason: Employee E034 (Matthew Mejia) requested write access to Payroll. There is conflicting evidence about employment type: HR reports full_time Analyst, while the Security agent independently looked up its own database and reports contractor with basic security training. The other agents (IT, Finance, Compliance, Facilities) did not independently verify employment type and only repeated HR's value. Per policy, contractors may have read, or write only with advanced security training — never admin. With basic security training, the maximum access for a contractor is read. Since the requested write level exceeds the maximum, I grant the maximum: read.

If full_time Analyst: requested write = max write → grant write.
If contractor with basic training: max read → grant read.
